verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own machine credentials for agents: API keys for programmatic callers and M2M tokens for calls between agents. It also offers OAuth scoped access with custom scopes for MCP clients, and can gate agent tool calls against the caller's permissions and scopes. However, the evidence never shows per-key scope or permission restriction on the API keys or M2M tokens themselves, so least-privilege issuance is only implied by combining these features. missing for 10: documented per-credential scope/permission assignment on API keys and M2M tokens, expiry and rotation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
